{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Compute total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Identify the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = revenue_by_channel.loc[revenue_by_channel['revenue_numeric'].idxmax()]

# Extract the channel name and total revenue
best_channel_name = best_channel['channel']
best_channel_revenue = best_channel['revenue_numeric']

(best_channel_name, best_channel_revenue)"}
